metadata.title: docs: add PostgreSQL and team limit troubleshooting entries
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
## Summary

- Add troubleshooting entry for `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'psycopg2'` when `DATABASE_URL` uses `postgresql://` instead of `postgresql+psycopg://`, with links to SQLAlchemy documentation
- Add troubleshooting entry for "Team has reached maximum member limit" error, explaining the `MAX_MEMBERS_PER_TEAM` setting and per-team override via Admin API

## Test plan

- [ ] Verify MkDocs renders both new sections correctly (`mkdocs serve`)
- [ ] Confirm internal links to configuration reference resolve

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
This section describes `psycopg2` as "deprecated", but the project ADR states psycopg2 is in maintenance mode and simply not supported by ContextForge. To avoid overstating upstream deprecation, consider rephrasing to "legacy/maintenance-mode psycopg2 driver" and emphasize that it isn't installed/supported here.
```suggestion
ContextForge ships with [psycopg 3](https://www.psycopg.org/psycopg3/) (`psycopg`), the modern PostgreSQL adapter. However, SQLAlchemy's default `postgresql://` scheme loads the legacy/maintenance-mode `psycopg2` driver, which is not installed or supported by ContextForge.
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
This curl example uses `PATCH` and an `/api/v1/teams/...` URL, but the gateway exposes `PUT /teams/{team_id}` for updating teams (no `/api/v1` prefix, and no PATCH handler). As written, the request will fail; please update the method/path to match the actual route.
```suggestion
curl -X PUT http://localhost:4444/teams/{team_id} \
```

comments.author: Copilot
comments.body:
The text says this can be changed via the "Admin API", but the implemented `update_team` route is the normal Teams endpoint and is restricted to the team **owner** (it checks the caller's team role == `owner`, not `is_admin`). Please adjust wording so operators know which credentials/role are required.
```suggestion
Alternatively, update the limit on a specific team via the standard Teams API, using a token for that team's owner:
```

commits.message:
docs: add PostgreSQL psycopg2 and team member limit troubleshooting entries

Add two new sections to the troubleshooting guide:
- PostgreSQL psycopg2 ModuleNotFoundError when DATABASE_URL uses the
  wrong dialect scheme (should be postgresql+psycopg://)
- Team member limit exceeded error with guidance on adjusting
  MAX_MEMBERS_PER_TEAM globally or per-team via the Admin API

Signed-off-by: Jonathan Springer <jps@s390x.com>
